title: Track A (fixed +$15 / -$15): the eight hypotheses not already tested by B1-B27, each on its own, with every entry mechanism

approval: Operator, 2026-11-08 (chat, Phase C): "TRACK A - FIXED +-$15 BENCHMARK ... Test each hypothesis independently before testing combinations ... Do not repeat B26 and B27 without a specific new hypothesis ... Every new experiment must be registered BEFORE its results are examined."
unsealed_data_also_used: 2026 (from 2026-01-01, scored from 2026-03-01) and the live store's 5m bars, only to CHECK candidates frozen on development; validation and holdout are not read
coverage: research/PHASE_C_PLAN.md section 1: the 15 listed hypotheses mapped to B1-B27; only the eight below are new. Fades are not separate hypotheses: on mid prices a fade is the mirror of the move (B26 mirror check, 100%).
trade: B27's trade exactly (quantum.research.b27 / b26): decision at a 15m close, fill at the next open (ask / bid), +-$15 from the actual fill, exit-side triggers, same-bar = stop, gaps, 2-day limit, closure exits; ENG costs primary

families.LONDON_ORB: Opening range = the two 15m bars from 08:00 Europe/London local time. From 08:30 to 11:00 local, the first 15m close above the range high is +1 (below the low -1), once per day. Limit level: the range edge.
families.NY_ORB: The same with 09:30 America/New_York, window to 12:00 local.
families.ENGULF_LEVEL: Bullish engulfing (previous bar down, this bar up, this body >= the previous body and >= 0.5 ATR14, open <= previous close, close >= previous open) whose low is within 0.5 ATR of, or through, a support: the previous New York day's low, today's Asian low (from 07:00 UTC) or the prior 20-bar low: +1. Bearish mirror at the previous day's high / Asian high / 20-bar high: -1. Limit level: half the body.
families.PINBAR_LEVEL: Bullish pin bar (lower wick >= 2/3 of the range, body <= 1/3, range >= 1 ATR14) at the same supports: +1; bearish mirror: -1. Limit level: the bar's midpoint.
families.CHOCH_RETEST: The first bar of a structure flip (the engine's latest BOS / MSS / CHoCH direction differs from the one before; B27 sg_flip): direction = the new direction. Limit level: the flip bar's midpoint.
families.OB_RETEST: A displacement candle (range >= 2 ATR14, body >= 70% of range; B27) with an order block (the last opposite-colour candle within the 5 bars before): trigger at the displacement close, its direction. Limit level: the order block's near edge (bullish: its high; bearish: its low).
families.SWEEP_DISPLACEMENT: A sweep in direction d (the engine's SWEEP, a PDH / PDL sweep-and-reclaim, or a failed 20-bar breakout; B27) followed within 4 bars by a displacement candle in direction d: trigger at that candle, direction d. Limit level: half its body.
families.SUPERTREND: Supertrend on 15m (ATR 10, multiplier 3; standard final-band recursion, closes only): a flip to up is +1, to down -1. Limit level: the Supertrend line at the flip.

entry_modes: IMM; CONF_X (first 15m close X beyond the trigger close before the original stop trigger -+ $15, within 96 bars; fill at the next open; +-$15 from that fill), RETEST_X (a limit at the confirmation level for 8 bars after it), STOP_X (a stop order at trigger +- X); X in {3, 5, 8, 10, 15, 20}; LIMIT (the family's level, only on the adverse side 0.5 .. 14 away, 8 bars). Fill-bar rule: an intrabar fill's bar counts only against the trade. 20 modes.
statistics: B27's: decided TP-first rate on the independent series with a Wilson interval; matched random (same direction, session, month; B26 all-bar) as primary and direction-neutral (mean of BUY and SELL) reported beside it; exact one-sided binomial; BH q = 0.05 over B28's configurations; expectancy (ENG; OP and ADV for cost sensitivity), profit factor, drawdown, Monte Carlo drawdown, longest losing run, holding time to TP and to SL, neither share, trades per week, monthly results, results by volatility tercile / trend / session
tiers: INFORMATIVE: BH-significant, lower bound above matched random, >= 300 independent trades. TRADEABLE: also lower bound above break-even and positive ENG expectancy.
combinations: Formed only from INFORMATIVE single hypotheses (B27 or B28). If there are none, no combination is tested: combining factors that each failed is a search, not a hypothesis.
frozen_for_2026: Every INFORMATIVE configuration (at most 20), the 5 best by development lower bound with >= 300 trades, and the 5 best with 30-299; checked on 2026 with Holm
decision: None here. A TRADEABLE candidate that holds on 2026 is proposed as one hypothesis for the sealed validation period, which needs the operator's approval.
